## What this changes


## For new wallpapers

- [ ] Each image is at least 1920 px on its long edge and at most 25 MB.
- [ ] Filenames use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
- [ ] Each image has an entry in `data/wallpapers.yml` with a title and two to five tags.
- [ ] No watermarks, nothing explicit, no duplicates.
- [ ] The artist is credited where known, and allows the work to be shared.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes.

## For changes to the site

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run check` pass.
- [ ] Pages still work with JavaScript turned off.
- [ ] Nothing is loaded from another site.
